item.title: Putting Tokyo Rizz to the Test
item.description: Tokyo Sims puts people’s flirting skills to the test on the streets of Tokyo. From smooth attempts to awkward fumbles, not everyone’s rizz works quite as planned.

item.title: Adventures of nanpa boy
item.description: Follow Nanpa Boy through the streets of Tokyo as he approaches strangers and finds himself in some unpredictable interactions. You never quite know where the next conversation will lead.
